leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct an Angular component with TypeScript to serve as the foundation for an accordion
Implement component state to control the expanded or collapsed state of each accordion item
Apply Angular event binding to toggle the visibility of accordion content on user interaction
Configure structural directives to conditionally render content based on the accordion state
Integrate CSS classes dynamically to visually indicate the expanded or collapsed state of accordion items
Manipulate component data to manage multiple accordion items within a single component instance
Initialize and bind component properties to pass data into the accordion for dynamic content display
